---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[feature] "

## Problem / motivation
What are you trying to do, and what's missing or painful today?

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see. Be as concrete as you can.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about, and why this one.

## Scope / area
Which part does this touch? (agents, tools, sandbox, eval harness, graph/serving, docs, …)

## Additional context
Anything else — examples, links, prior art.
